protocol.selection: Closest contained settled count, shorter duration/lower tilt
protocol.missing_recipe: Validate closest candidate and report unresolved
protocol.refinement: Bisect observed count gaps; finite boundary grid otherwise
protocol.seed_zero_overlap: Seed 0 is the discovery start; seeds 1/2 are new

extra_probe_protocol.reason: Probe missing one/four and duration sensitivity after angle discovery

render_protocol.selection: Best explicit-target attempt from frozen checks and extra probes
render_protocol.ties: Exact Pour, contained count error, full sequence, then seed
render_protocol.playback: Pick/Place 4x; complete Pour 1x; chapter 2 s/result 3 s
